five_dataset.note: pairs are generated by sbgv8/independent_validation/datasets.py (templated base_src/variant_src with built-in trigger_discriminating inputs); no adjudicated labels exist, so false-assurance risk is not estimable; benchmark change_type is a design category, not ground truth

dev_records.evidence: experiments/v8/dev_collect.py runs each pair as a subprocess `python -m sbgv8 compare base variant` (V7-B engine) and builds records via adapter.load_record; all 312 records carry run_meta rc=0 with wall time and a verified log head; all 1976 inputs have provenance 'declared'; outcomes SAME 1863 / CONFIRMED_DIFF 84 / LIMIT_ASYMMETRIC 22 / NO_RUN 6 / QUARANTINED 1.
dev_records.labels: scripts/build_dev_pairs_csv.py: quixbugs Y=1 iff the benchmark's declared tests distinguish buggy from fixed (B2 oracle); synthetic Y from generator mutation label (CHANGED vs semantics-preserving); quixbugs_neg Y=0 by construction; bugsinpy_units unlabelled. Not derived from SBG verdicts.
dev_records.leakage: profile.py / ers.py / perturb.py / policy.py never read rec.y or rec.meta (docstrings + grep); calibrate reads y only for training/threshold fitting on training folds.
dev_records.caveats: (i) quixbugs arm: label oracle and SBG evidence use the same declared inputs (shared-input coupling; a Y=1 quixbugs pair is almost always a witness/DIV, so it rarely reaches NDO); (ii) labels are generator/benchmark labels, not adjudicated; (iii) raw run directories (results/repro/v8_dev_20261118_195446) are not present in this worktree, so logs were not re-verified here.

linux_dev_eval.evidence: results/v8_dev_eval_20261119_* are evaluate.run over datasets/v8/dev_records.jsonl (same md5 as mac); no new execution; seed-0 OOF predictions re-generated here reproduce saved log loss/Brier exactly.

linux_perturbation_ers.evidence: results/v8/linux/perturb/posthoc_matrix.* and ers/ers_matrix.json are recorded-evidence transformations (P2/P5/P6 marked 'synthetic recorded input'); no Linux real-execution perturbation raw files exist under results/v8/linux, so real-execution claims in the Linux reports are report-only.

five_dataset.evidence: sbgv8/independent_validation/executor.py assigns CONFIRMED_DIFF/SAME from change_type and test purpose (no program execution); pairs are templates from datasets.py; verdict == construction for 250/250. Excluded from all tables and figures.
